    As of March 2026, Taylor Frankie Paul has three children: daughter Indy (born Aug. 31, 2017, age 8), son Ocean (born June 18, 2020, age 5), and son Ever (born March 19, 2024, age 2). She shares Indy and Ocean with ex-husband Tate Paul, and her youngest, Ever, with ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen. 
    • Indy May Paul (Age 8): Born in 2017, she is the oldest child.
    • Ocean Paul (Age 5): Born in 2020, he is the middle child.
    • Ever True Mortensen (Age 2): Born in March 2024. 
    Taylor often shares content featuring her kids on social media, notes Today.com. She has stated her kids are kept off
    The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives show for their privacy, according to AOL.com.
